description: Read an exception stack trace (Java/JVM, Python, Node, Go, .NET, Rust, Ruby or PHP) and answer the only question anyone asks it: WHERE TO LOOK. Follows the "Caused by" chain to the root cause, separates your code from the framework, and points at your first frame. Infers which package is yours from the trace itself if you do not say.

myPrefixes.description: Prefixes of your own code, e.g. ["com.acme.", "src/"]

name: log_stacktrace
